# Dean Palermo
Digital Growth, AI, Content & Marketing Technology Leader
Location: Davie, Florida
Website: https://deanpalermo.com/
Portfolio: https://elettro.com/
LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/deanpalermo

Professional summary:
Dean Palermo has 20+ years of experience building customer acquisition programs, digital platforms, content systems, ecommerce operations and high-volume marketing programs. His current work combines executive-level production leadership with hands-on expertise across generative AI, paid media, SEO/AIO, analytics, ecommerce, custom web development, automation and cloud infrastructure.

Current proof points:
- Completed 50+ comprehensive SEO and AI Optimization audits within an intensive two-month period in 2026.
- Rebuilt and optimized selected properties using custom HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JSON-LD, GitHub Pages, WordPress, Shopify and cloud infrastructure, with multiple properties reaching 90+ targeted SEO and AI optimization benchmarks.
- Conceived, architected, developed and launched Stashbox Radio as a proprietary music, video, advertising, ecommerce, analytics and content-management platform using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Node.js, AWS Lambda, API Gateway, PostgreSQL/RDS, S3, REST APIs, GitHub Pages and Shopify integrations.
- Produced and distributed 170+ original songs. Grew the Stashbox YouTube channel from 115 to 6,700+ subscribers in approximately two months.
- Built SolarMeister from concept to market as a Germany-only, German-language residential solar ecommerce brand for Neckermann Strom GmbH.
- Designed and developed the SolarMeister Shopify platform supporting approximately 3,000 purchasable product variations.
- Developed SolarMeister supplier-product synchronization workflows governing inventory availability, product status, pricing and variants.
- Built SolarMeister acquisition infrastructure across Google Search Console, Google Merchant Center, Google Ads, Google Business Profile, GA4, product feeds, conversion tracking, structured data and search visibility.
- Led global organic social production at Audible / Amazon supporting approximately $15 million in annual production activity and a 42-person organization across 10 international markets.

AI and production stack:
Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, AI-assisted coding, agentic workflows, prompt systems, Runway, MidJourney, FLUX, Suno, ElevenLabs, Pro Tools, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, Laravel, Node.js, AWS Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS, Shopify, GA4, Google Merchant Center, Google Ads, Search Console, JSON-LD, Salesforce, Jira, Confluence and Airtable.
